description: This file defines the interface 'JsonPointer' which models a path within a JSON object, enabling hierarchical navigation and manipulation of JSON keys. It includes methods for creating, extending, trimming, and querying JSON pointers, highlighting its role in JSON structure handling within the project.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer represented by the string "/".

methods.name: of
methods.description: Parses a slash-delimited string to create a new JsonPointer, supporting escaped tildes.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer by adding a JSON key as a new leaf level.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Concatenates another JsonPointer to this one, creating a combined path.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels (keys) in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON pointer has no elements.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specified level, if present.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root key of the JSON pointer, if it exists.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the leaf key of the JSON pointer, if it exists.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Removes the leaf element, returning a new pointer.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Moves to the next sub level, excluding the current root.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-path from a specified level upwards.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a path from the root to a specified level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector including this pointer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the slash-delimited string representation of the path.
